reviewItem.question: Does "CLI-based Injection of Global Context Entries: Kyverno CLI now allows you to dynamically inject global context entries using a Values file" mean a change to cli-flag:kyverno|name=global-context-injection-via-values-file|component=kyverno-cli (added)?

proposed.statement: Kyverno CLI now supports dynamically injecting global context entries using a Values file, allowing simulation of different scenarios during policy testing without modifying cluster resources.
